sources.h1: Custom Guitar Innovations 2 In 1 Fuzz Pedal
sources.excerpt: Effects Database documents the Custom Guitar Innovations 2 In 1 Fuzz Pedal as a hand-built two-in-one fuzz based on two Fuzz Face-style voices. The record describes a switchable design intended to provide two distinct fuzz tones in one enclosure, using NKT-275 germanium transistors. It also lists true bypass, a printed circuit board, an aluminum enclosure, matched transistors, Switchcraft connectors, and a DC jack. The exact model is associated with Custom Guitar Innovations and was published as a documented pedal entry.
